content.json:
# Docket Filter Usage

Usage metrics for CAMS-850: how often each Court Docket filter is used, how usage compares across the four filters, which combinations of filters get used together, and what share of Court Docket panel sessions engage with filtering at all — to inform display order and removal decisions.

**Instrumented events** (all in `customEvents`):
- `Docket Text Search Filter Changed` / `Cleared` — 500ms-debounced free-text search in the docket
- `Docket Document Number Filter Changed` / `Cleared` — 500ms-debounced jump-to-document-number; `Cleared` also fires when a non-numeric value replaces a valid one, so its count includes validation churn, not only deliberate clears
- `Docket Summary Filter Changed` / `Cleared` — multi-select facet picker, immediate (no debounce)
- `Docket Date Range Start Only Filter Changed` / `Docket Date Range End Only Filter Changed` / `Docket Date Range Complete Filter Changed` / `Docket Date Range Filter Cleared` — start/end date picker, immediate (no debounce); which Changed event fires depends on whether only the start, only the end, or both bounds are currently set
- `Docket All Filters Cleared` — fired once when Clear All Filters is used and at least one filter was active; suppresses the 4 per-field Cleared events above for that action, so those now reflect manual single-field clears only
- `Docket Filters Combination Changed` / `Cleared` — fired whenever the set of currently-populated filters changes, carrying a `filters` property (a fixed, comma-joined list of field labels — e.g. `TextSearch,Summary` — never raw values)

No event carries the actual search text, document number, selected values, or dates. All `Cleared` events carry no properties. The only property anywhere in this feature is `Combination Changed`'s `filters` field, always a combination of a small, fixed set of field-name labels — a `customDimensions` field, never `customMeasurements`.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name in (
    "Docket Text Search Filter Changed",
    "Docket Document Number Filter Changed",
    "Docket Summary Filter Changed",
    "Docket Date Range Start Only Filter Changed",
    "Docket Date Range End Only Filter Changed",
    "Docket Date Range Complete Filter Changed"
  )
| extend Filter = case(
    name == "Docket Text Search Filter Changed", "Text Search",
    name == "Docket Document Number Filter Changed", "Document Number",
    name == "Docket Summary Filter Changed", "Summary",
    name has "Date Range", "Date Range",
    name
  )
| summarize ChangedCount = count() by Filter
| order by ChangedCount desc
content.title: Filter Usage Volume (Relative Frequency Across All 4 Filters)

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name in (
    "Docket Text Search Filter Changed", "Docket Text Search Filter Cleared",
    "Docket Document Number Filter Changed", "Docket Document Number Filter Cleared",
    "Docket Summary Filter Changed", "Docket Summary Filter Cleared",
    "Docket Date Range Start Only Filter Changed",
    "Docket Date Range End Only Filter Changed",
    "Docket Date Range Complete Filter Changed",
    "Docket Date Range Filter Cleared"
  )
| extend Filter = case(
    name has "Text Search", "Text Search",
    name has "Document Number", "Document Number",
    name has "Summary", "Summary",
    name has "Date Range", "Date Range",
    name
  )
| summarize
    Changed = countif(name has "Changed"),
    Cleared = countif(name has "Cleared")
  by Filter
| order by Changed desc
content.title: Changed vs. Cleared Events per Filter

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name in (
    "Docket Text Search Filter Changed", "Docket Text Search Filter Cleared",
    "Docket Document Number Filter Changed", "Docket Document Number Filter Cleared",
    "Docket Summary Filter Changed", "Docket Summary Filter Cleared",
    "Docket Date Range Start Only Filter Changed",
    "Docket Date Range End Only Filter Changed",
    "Docket Date Range Complete Filter Changed",
    "Docket Date Range Filter Cleared"
  )
| summarize
    TextSearchChanged = countif(name == "Docket Text Search Filter Changed"),
    TextSearchCleared = countif(name == "Docket Text Search Filter Cleared"),
    DocNumberChanged = countif(name == "Docket Document Number Filter Changed"),
    DocNumberCleared = countif(name == "Docket Document Number Filter Cleared"),
    SummaryChanged = countif(name == "Docket Summary Filter Changed"),
    SummaryCleared = countif(name == "Docket Summary Filter Cleared"),
    DateRangeChanged = countif(name has "Date Range" and name has "Changed"),
    DateRangeCleared = countif(name == "Docket Date Range Filter Cleared")
  by Day = bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by Day asc
content.title: Filter Activity Over Time (All 4 Filters, Changed + Cleared)

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name in (
    "Docket Date Range Start Only Filter Changed",
    "Docket Date Range End Only Filter Changed",
    "Docket Date Range Complete Filter Changed"
  )
| extend RangeType = case(
    name == "Docket Date Range Start Only Filter Changed", "Start Only",
    name == "Docket Date Range End Only Filter Changed", "End Only",
    "Complete Range"
  )
| summarize ChangedCount = count() by RangeType
| order by ChangedCount desc
content.title: Date Range Usage by Type (Start Only / End Only / Complete)

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "Docket All Filters Cleared"
| summarize ClearAllCount = count()
content.title: Clear All Filters — Usage Count

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "Docket Filters Combination Changed"
| extend Combination = tostring(customDimensions.filters)
| summarize UsageCount = count() by Combination
| order by UsageCount desc
content.title: Filter Combinations in Use

content.query:
let DocketPanelSessions = pageViews
    | where timestamp {TimeRange}
    | where url contains "court-docket"
    | distinct session_Id;
let TotalSessions = toscalar(DocketPanelSessions | count);
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name in (
    "Docket Text Search Filter Changed",
    "Docket Document Number Filter Changed",
    "Docket Summary Filter Changed",
    "Docket Date Range Start Only Filter Changed",
    "Docket Date Range End Only Filter Changed",
    "Docket Date Range Complete Filter Changed"
  )
| join kind=inner DocketPanelSessions on session_Id
| summarize SessionsUsingAnyFilter = dcount(session_Id)
| extend TotalSessions = toscalar(DocketPanelSessions | count)
| extend PctSessionsUsingAnyFilter = round(iif(TotalSessions > 0, todouble(SessionsUsingAnyFilter) / todouble(TotalSessions) * 100, 0.0), 1)
| project SessionsUsingAnyFilter, TotalSessions, PctSessionsUsingAnyFilter
content.title: Overall Filter Adoption — % of Court Docket Panel Sessions Using Any Filter
